run.engine_version: m1.2b-2 (D-070 build; live shadow m1.2e / D-074; D-084 adopt) + C2 pass rate (m1.2x) + YPA per attempt (m1.2z) + E-SP-2 prior + E-SP-3a K + E-SP-T tripwire + Layer A repaired (Nacua clause) + m1.2y roster rule + m1.2i top-cell raise x1.0434
run.scoring_basis: half_ppr_v1: the weighted sum of the GENERATION'S OWN stat means (pass yds 0.04, pass TD 4, rush yds 0.1, reception 0.5, rec yds 0.1, touchdown 6) — exact for a mean, because expectation is linear. Half-PPR's two negative components, interceptions and fumbles lost, are NOT in this number: the engine projects neither (D-075 point 3), so a passer's total is high by whatever his interceptions would have cost
run.line_of_record: per (player, market): each book's LATEST capture at each line is the row of record; the MAIN LINE is the line the most books quote (one book, one vote), ties breaking on the LOWER line; and the price carried on the row is the OVER price from the book whose capture at that line is the MOST RECENT, ties breaking on the book name. It is a price a named book actually posted — never a median, never a best-of, never a shopped number
run.share_prior: this generation carries no early-season share prior record: the archive holds no fitted K for it, and none is recomputed here. The K a generation shrank by is fitted inside that generation and stated in its own run log (E-SP-T, D-128)
run.disclosure: Known bias (D-070): top-tier rushing runs ~2-4% low (star carry share −5.6%). Corrections are tested weekly against live results before adoption.

It is as sparse as the captures are; fewer than two points is a line that has only just posted, and the client says so rather than drawing a sparkline through one dot

projected_line.label: aDOT
projected_line.reason: aDOT is not an engine object: the chain allocates targets and applies yards per RECEPTION, and average depth of target is neither of those. It is not estimated from the numbers around it
